newsitem.title: USA: Cycomm unit in reseller deal with GTE.
newsitem.headline: Cycomm unit in reseller deal with GTE.

text.p: Cycomm International Inc said Monday its XL Computing Corp subsidiary entered into a distribution agreement with GTE Corp for XL's PCMobile line of laptops.
Cycomm said the agreement allows GTE to resell the complete product line of XL Computing, including PCMobile and related hardware, software.
Cycomm said GTE estimates it may buy $3 million worth of XL's products during the next twelve months.
It said GTE has placed an initial order for 42 PCMobile units to begin a project in Muskegon, Ill. that will require a total of 80 PCMobile units.
Cycomm said PCMobile is a laptop computer developed for optimal mobility, flexibility and performance under severe operating conditions.
It said a sealed magnesium housing allows the unit to be dropped three feet on concrete while being used in the rain or withstanding liquid spills.
Also, the backlit keyboard allows for operation at night, and the screen is visible in direct sunlight.
